title: A shoulder at Gully's
logline: The end stool from behind: a shoulder in plaid, a coffee, and Gully's hand on the counter beside it. The first time the two of them share a private page.

panels.composition: The counter at Gully's from behind the end stool: a man's shoulder and the back of his head, a coffee before him, and a thick hand in a canvas cuff resting on the counter beside the cup. Neither face. The corkboard above, the 2003 rough at its center.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, seen from behind a shop's end stool, a man's shoulder in plaid flannel and the back of his graying head with a coffee before him and a stocky man's hand resting on the counter beside it, a crowded corkboard above, no faces, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
